Q: Deleting all documents in Firestore collection A:

In 2024 the managed bulk delete service greatly simplified this operation, but this service incurs cost per deleted document just like the workarounds listed in this thread.

In 2026 things got much better however. Now there is a drop() operation via MongoDB compatibility API which costs a single delete operation for the entire collection as opposed to per deleted document. It is much faster and much more cost effective.

Q: Powershell "You cannot run this script on the current system" A:

Install-PSResource runs its Authenticode check against your LocalMachine policy (RemoteSigned), and the downloaded PrettyLs.psd1 is unsigned + carries Mark-of-the-Web from Temp, so it's blocked despite CurrentUser = Unrestricted.

Use this to Fix:

Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass -Force
Install-PSResource -Name PrettyLs -TrustRepository -Reinstall

Q: is it possible for exporting only functions in mysql workbench A:

Create a dummy table in the database. Go to Menu Server -> Data Export then Select the Schema and only the dummy table and click Dump Store Procedures and Functions and Dump Structure only. Select Export to a Self contained File. Once exported you get the dummy table Create statement plus all the procedures and functions, open the sql file where you want to import and select the functions and execute.
